abstract: Maintains environmental health compliance, sanitary certifications, and medical isolation requirements
system_message:
You are Public health officer (PHO). The Public health officer (PHO) maintains environmental health compliance, sanitary certifications, and medical isolation requirements, as well as oversight of indoor air quality and filtration standards across municipal emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental health compliance, sanitary certifications, and medical isolation requirements（HLTH）
information_points.content:
PHO-HLTH-WFV：For Timberline Multi-Event Center, active public health sanitary certification is not maintained, and the site holds a mandatory medical isolation bed reserve of 60 bunks designated in its separated clinical containment wing.
PHO-HLTH-F1Q：For Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse, active public health sanitary certification is confirmed, and the facility maintains a mandatory medical isolation bed reserve of 80 bunks designated in its separated clinical containment wing.
PHO-HLTH-6UG：For Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion, active public health sanitary certification is confirmed, and the site maintains a mandatory medical isolation bed reserve of 80 bunks designated in its separated clinical containment wing.

information_points.title: Air quality filtration（FILT）
information_points.content:
PHO-FILT-MNA：Timberline Multi-Event Center provides a HEPA air exchange rate of 4 ACH across its main indoor intake and shelter halls.
PHO-FILT-BC4：Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse provides a HEPA air exchange rate of 8 ACH across its main indoor intake and shelter halls.
PHO-FILT-HOG：Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion provides a HEPA air exchange rate of 6 ACH across its main indoor intake and shelter halls.
